cost.scope: authorized pod uptime from successful start through final receipt

disclosure.co_tenancy: The original pod was shared with an unrelated CPU-only task but had no GPU capacity, so the owner authorized a same-region clone on a separate host. The clone had no unrelated task inside its container; the provider host may still be multi-tenant. Every warm-up and measured cell sampled host load average and CPU utilization; any load1 sample above half the host logical core count contaminated and reran the entire stage.
disclosure.fallback: Disabled because the contract colocates one R1b MTP vLLM replica; fallback share is reported as zero rather than pretending the same physical replica is independent.

measurement_side.gateway: gateway Prometheus counter deltas and gauge polling
measurement_side.latency: client monotonic wall clock around streamed OpenAI HTTP requests

capacity.capacity_definition: highest offered Poisson QPS meeting error, deadline, achieved-QPS, and p95 gates

profile_evidence.interpretation: The matched profile shows lower p95 latency and higher throughput with materially fewer polling-related calls, while p50 latency regressed; the mixed result is retained without claiming a universal latency win.

optimization.summary: Adaptive queued-admission polling backoff from 5 ms to 10 ms and then 20 ms while preserving immediate first admission and deadline semantics

profile_evidence.profiler: GNU gprof 2.38 (-pg); matched 80-request gateway profile cells, with multithread call counts interpreted directionally
